description: This file defines the LocationSync class, which implements plugin, web, and JSON-RPC interfaces for location synchronization in the WPEFramework. It includes nested classes for data representation, notification handling, and configuration, along with method declarations for initialization, deinitialization, and location management.

classes.name: LocationSync
classes.description: Main plugin class handling location synchronization, web requests, and JSON-RPC communication.

classes.name: LocationSync::Data
classes.description: JSON container for location data including IP, timezone, region, country, and city.

classes.name: LocationSync::Notification
classes.description: Handles location change notifications and probing location services.

classes.name: LocationSync::Config
classes.description: Configuration container for sync interval, retries, and source.

methods.name: LocationSync::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given shell service.

methods.name: LocationSync::Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and generates responses.
